# @circle-fin/borrow-kit

## 1.3.0

### Minor Changes

- Name the Borrow Service refusal sent while Circle pauses BorrowKit loan
  writes. It previously arrived as a generic, `FATAL` `INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED`.

  - `BorrowError.PAUSED` (`BORROW_PAUSED`, code 8205, `RETRYABLE`): Circle has
    paused this loan write on every chain or on one chain. A pause can cover
    only some writes. Other writes, such as `repay`, can still work. Retry
    later. Loan reads and quotes still work during a pause. The error keeps the
    service's message.

### Patch Changes

- `claimRewards` now returns `BorrowError.PAUSED` (`BORROW_PAUSED`, `RETRYABLE`)
  while Circle pauses EarnKit writes. `claimRewards` uses the shared kits claim
  endpoint, and the EarnKit pause also covers that endpoint. The refusal
  previously arrived as a generic, `FATAL` `INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED`. The error
  keeps the service's message.
- CCTPx is now configured for Ink, HyperEVM and World Chain on mainnet and testnet (Ink Testnet, HyperEVM Testnet and World Chain Sepolia). These chains now report CCTPx support, so CCTPx routes to and from them can be used.

## 1.2.0

### Minor Changes

- Name three Borrow Service refusals that previously arrived as a generic,
  `FATAL` `INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED`. Each keeps the service's message.

  - `BorrowError.LOAN_OPENING_PENDING` (`BORROW_LOAN_OPENING_PENDING`, code
    1226, `RETRYABLE`): a write or quote addressed a loan that is still
    opening: its signed opening `borrow` has not landed yet, or has landed and
    is still being processed. Retry shortly.
  - `BorrowError.LOAN_OPENING_EXPIRED` (`BORROW_LOAN_OPENING_EXPIRED`, code
    1227, `FATAL`): the loan's signed opening `borrow` expired without landing.
    Call `borrow({ loanId })` again to open it; retrying the same request will
    not help.
  - `BorrowError.INSUFFICIENT_MARKET_LIQUIDITY`
    (`BORROW_INSUFFICIENT_MARKET_LIQUIDITY`, code 1228, `FATAL`): the requested
    borrow exceeds what the market can currently lend. The error message names
    the requested and available amounts, so you can borrow at most the
    available amount.

- `Blockchain.Celo_Sepolia` (chain identifier `'Celo_Sepolia'`) is now in the chain registry, and `Blockchain.Celo_Alfajores_Testnet` is deprecated because Celo shut down the Alfajores testnet; it stays exported until the next major version. Borrow Kit adds no Celo Sepolia support.
- **Behavioral change:** `isRetryableError(error)` now respects `FATAL` for every error code. Before, it returned `true` for a `FATAL` error with one of these codes:

  - 3001 `NETWORK_CONNECTION_FAILED`
  - 3002 `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`
  - 4001 `RPC_ENDPOINT_ERROR`
  - 4002 `RPC_INVALID_RESPONSE`

  `retry()` now rejects fatal RPC submission errors and batch confirmation timeouts, because the original transaction may already have been submitted. Before you start the operation again, find out if the earlier transaction landed.

### Patch Changes

- Borrow Kit error telemetry now names the error behind a failure. When a write
  fails with an error from outside the kit, such as a wallet error, the error
  event's message names that error. The message holds the error's class name and
  the step that failed, plus its numeric code when it has one, for example
  `TransactionExecutionError code=4001 step=execute`. `BorrowErrorTrace.rawError`
  exposes a redacted `{ name, message?, code? }` projection of it, or a string for
  a non-`Error` throw. The message never contains error text, addresses or
  amounts. Error codes, types and recoverability are unchanged.
- Borrow Kit loan writes (`borrow`, `repay`, `addCollateral`, `closeLoan`,
  `withdrawCollateralRepayIfNeeded`, and `retry`) now report a success event when
  the batch is confirmed or submitted, and both success and error events carry
  the loan ID when it is known, so Circle can match a failed or completed write
  to its loan. A first `borrow` that fails before its loan bundle is signed has
  no loan ID yet, so its error event carries none. A confirmed write also
  carries its transaction hash, and a failed write carries the hash of its last
  step when it has one. Wallet addresses are never sent. Turn off success events
  with `disableAnalytics` and error events with `disableErrorReporting`.
- The `retry()` example in the README and API docs now waits before retrying. Some retryable failures need time to clear, such as a loan that is still opening or a pause of loan writes, which can last minutes or longer, so retrying right away usually fails again.
- Keep the execution signature out of the whole serialized error trace. When a
  failed loan write already carried trace fields, such as an adapter's
  `rawError.message` holding the submitted calldata, Borrow Kit now scrubs the
  signature from every string in them, not only from the steps and the message.
  An `Error` carried in the trace, at the top level or nested, is reduced to its
  redacted `{ name, message }` projection, so its enumerable fields (such as a viem
  error's `metaMessages`) cannot repeat the calldata. The signature stays intact
  on `trace.execution` for retries.
- Chain definitions now list the EURC contract address on World Chain Sepolia, `0xe479EcA5740Ac65d6E1823bea2f1C08Bc14e954F`, matching the token registry.
- With `@circle-fin/adapter-viem-v2` 1.20.0 (`/next`):
  - `repay`, `closeLoan`, `withdrawCollateralRepayIfNeeded`, and `addCollateral` from a plain EOA on Arc fail before sending with `BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT_GAS` when the wallet cannot cover the native-USDC pull plus quoted gas, instead of reverting with "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance".
  - A transient RPC failure no longer disables batching until the adapter is recreated, so writes stop failing with `INPUT_UNSUPPORTED_ACTION` after one bad read.
  - `retry()` no longer resumes a write that failed with a `FATAL` wallet error, such as a chain mismatch or a `-32603` while submitting. Check whether the earlier transaction landed, then start the operation again.
  - When a wallet accepts a chain switch but still reports another chain, the write fails before submission with a retryable `INPUT_CHAIN_MISMATCH`; `retry()` resumes it once the wallet is on the right chain.

## 1.1.2

### Patch Changes

- EURC address updates in chain definitions.

  - `WorldChain.eurcAddress` is now set; it was previously `null`.
  - The EURC addresses on Avalanche, Avalanche Fuji, and Base now use EIP-55 checksum casing instead of all lowercase. If you compare these addresses with `===`, compare them case-insensitively instead.
  - EURC can now be looked up by symbol on Avalanche Fuji and Solana Devnet.

## 1.1.1

### Patch Changes

- Arc Testnet calls no longer fail with `HTTP request failed` when no custom RPC is configured. The default Arc Testnet RPC endpoint is now `https://rpc.testnet.arc.io`, replacing the retired `https://rpc.testnet.arc.network/` host. Apps that already pass their own Arc Testnet RPC URL or transport are unaffected.

## 1.1.0

### Minor Changes

- Add a `@circle-fin/borrow-kit/chains` subpath that exports the chain definitions Borrow Kit supports, so you can import definitions directly instead of calling `getChainByEnum`:

  ```ts
  import { ArcTestnet } from "@circle-fin/borrow-kit/chains";

  const { markets } = await kit.exploreMarkets({ chain: ArcTestnet });
  ```

  The subpath exports `Arc`, `ArcTestnet`, and `BorrowChain`.

### Patch Changes

- More EVM contract reverts now include a readable reason instead of a raw
  error selector. The SDK now also looks for the selector in the error's cause
  chain, in browser wallet errors, and in viem's raw revert data.

## 1.0.0

### Major Changes

- Introduce Borrow Kit, a typed SDK for over-collateralized USDC loans against
  Morpho markets on Arc (`BorrowChain.Arc`) and Arc Testnet
  (`BorrowChain.Arc_Testnet`). Each loan write (`borrow`, `repay`,
  `addCollateral`, `withdrawCollateralRepayIfNeeded`, `closeLoan`) is submitted
  as one atomic batch, so approvals and authorizations land together with the
  loan action or not at all.

  - Loans: `borrow`, `repay`, `addCollateral`, `withdrawCollateralRepayIfNeeded`
    and `closeLoan`, each with a matching quote, plus `getRequiredCollateral` and
    `getMaxBorrow` for sizing a borrow.
  - Reads: `getLoans`, `getPosition`, `getMarket`, `exploreMarkets` and
    `exploreMarketsIterator`.
  - Supported chains: `getSupportedChains`, on `BorrowKit` and as a standalone
    operation, returns the `BorrowChain` definitions the configured providers
    declare, keeping the last provider's definition when two providers declare
    the same chain.
  - Integrator and wallet operations: `getIntegratorConfig`,
    `setIntegratorConfig`, `registerWebhook`, and `claimRewards` with
    `getClaimRewardsQuote`.
  - Recovery: `retry` and `isRetryableError` for resubmitting a failed write.

  Loan writes from a plain EOA on Arc need `@circle-fin/adapter-viem-v2` 1.19.0
  or later, imported from `@circle-fin/adapter-viem-v2/next`.
